01-rls-disabled.description: RLS disabled on public.projects (the classic "we'll enable it later")
expectedFailures: select: alice sees org A's projects and nothing from org B
anon: the anon key reads zero rows from every table and view
every table in public has RLS enabled

02-update-without-tenant-check.description: UPDATE policy checks ownership but not the tenant column
expectedFailures: update: alice cannot move her project into org B

03-org-from-user-metadata.description: SELECT policy trusts org_id from user-editable user_metadata
expectedFailures: user_metadata: forging org_id = org B in her own metadata grants alice nothing

04-view-without-security-invoker.description: View recreated without security_invoker (runs as owner, bypasses RLS)
expectedFailures: view: project_overview only returns the caller's tenant
every view in public is security_invoker

05-security-definer-leak.description: RPC flipped to SECURITY DEFINER: no access check, no pinned search_path
expectedFailures: rpc: get_org_projects(org B) returns nothing for alice
every SECURITY DEFINER function in public pins search_path
